mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_line_string (property_id, destination_id, line_string) VALUES (#{propertyId}, #{destinationId}, #{lineStringJson})
mapper.select: SELECT property_id AS propertyId, destination_id AS destinationId, CAST(line_string AS CHAR) AS lineStringJson FROM test_line_string WHERE destination_id = #{destinationId} ORDER BY property_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
